note: Canonical files are maintained by hand and validated on every build; derived files are generated from them. Each sha256 is that of the file published in the same build: a mismatch means a file came from a different build (for example while a new version propagates through caches) or was altered.

resources.purpose: Evidence records: source URL and organisation, publication and retrieval dates, verbatim excerpts, classification, verification status and note. Defines the classifications and verification statuses it uses.
Entity types, lifecycle stages, project kinds, origins, domains and predicates (each defined), then entities and typed relationships, each citing records in evidence.json.
Evidence gaps: what is established (with records), what is not, what would resolve each, the records and data digest each assessment rests on, and the data checks re-run on every build.
Published registry versions, corrections, and the commit or pull request behind each.
One row per relationship between an organisation or initiative and what it acts on, with the rules used to derive each row.
The gap register as published, with computed relationship lists resolved; it omits the checks and digests kept in data/gaps.json.
